digest.component_or_area: Jira DC field readiness unit test
propositions: test_a_missing_epic_field_aborts_provisioning burns ~120 real seconds sleeping through the full production readiness budget when the stub guarantees the required field will never arrive

the readiness poll loop in await_required_fields always makes at least one request before checking deadline, then sleeps only if time remains, so a zero budget makes the test deterministic with exactly one field read and no sleep

JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT environment variable is already honored by _field_ready_timeout and passed explicitly to await_required_fields, providing a deterministic test seam that overrides the ambient environment

monkeypatching the constant FIELD_READY_BUDGET_S would be silently defeated if JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT is already set in the ambient environment, whereas setenv deterministically overrides either way
asserting the poll count (exactly one /rest/api/2/field read) is a stronger guard than a timing budget, since reaching a sleep requires another loop iteration which produces a second field read
